tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// dam can skyes bu'i las byang dang mngon rtogs bzhugs so//

"$ ༄༅// dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// las mkhan chen po bsgrub pa'i man ngag ni// rang nyid dpal phyag na rdo rje sgom pa la/ de'i mdun du pha wang long bu'i mkhar 'ja' tshon sna lnga bskor gcig bsgom de'i nang du padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la/ ra skyes kham pa ra las skar khung gsum rtsegs yod pa/ de'i steng du tri nag po de las 'od zer 'phros pas dgra bgegs gdug pa can tshar bcad de yongs su gyur pa las/ skyes bu chen po rdo rje legs par sku mdog mthing nag /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ zhal gdang zhing mche ba gtsigs pa dbu skra dmar ser gyen du 'bar ba zhal nas dug gi kha rlang 'thul ba/ phyag g.yas na khro chu'i tho ba/ g.yon na 'gar gyi sbud pa thog pa/ dar nag gi ber dgu brtsegs gsol ba/ 'khor mched zla sum brgya drug cu dang bcas pa sod cig rgyob cig pa'i sgra sgrogs pa/ za byed mche sder can pho nyar 'gyed pa bka' nyan cing las byed pa de lta bu gsal bar bsgom la/ ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni/ thugs ka'i tri las 'od zer 'phros nas ye shes pa spyan 'dren pa ni dam can 'khor dang bcas pa mdun du byon par bsam la/ dbyangs dang bcas pa 'di ltar ro// hūm̐ dam can skyes bu chen po ging gi bdag /dpal ldan dreg pa rta mgrin thugs las sprul// dam can skyes bu chen po mtshan can khyod// thugs rjes dbang gis gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ dam tshigs dbang gis stong gsum kun rgyu zhing*// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pas dgra bo rnams// thams cad dbyings su sgrol bar mdzad pa yi// nag pos tshogs dang bcas pas gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ dpal ldan skyes bus 'phrin las mdzad pa'i tshe/ dgra bgegs 'byung po 'dul bas don slad du// dpal ldan ging gi tshogs dang bcas pa rnams// gtor ma 'bul bas slad du gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ nyi ma byang phyogs pha ki ni// pha wong long bu'i sku mkhar nas/

ra skyes khams pa'i gdan steng nas// btsan gyi rgyal po gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ dpal ldan rta mgrin yang sprul 'jigs pas sku// dreg byed kun gyis rgyal po 'jig pa po/ rab khros yi dgas rgyal po dud mdog can// srog len dbug phrog 'bar ba gshegs su gsol// hūm̐ dpal ldan skyes bu'i 'phrin las mdzad pas tshe// mchod zla sum brgya drug bcur bcas pa dang*// za byed mche ba can dang bcas pa rnams// dgra bos sha khrag gsol shing tshur byon no// hūm̐ dpal ldan dbang phyug 'jig rten skyong bas gtso// 'gro bas don du thugs rjes skur sprul nas// bsgrub pa po la sdang ba'i dgra bgegs rnams/ 'dul mdzad skyes bu chen po tshur byon no// hūm̐ dreg pa 'dul phyir sku la ber nag gsol// 'gro drug dbyings su sgrol phyir spyan rtsa dmar/ dgra bgegs 'dul phyir smin ma ag tshom ser// nyon mongs bsreg byed zhal nas me 'bar zhing*// shang nas rlung nag 'tshub mar 'khyil pa'am// 'khor bas nyon mongs log lta 'jom par mdzad// dam can skyes bu chen po rdo rje gyi mtshan can khyod// ding 'di nas ni snying po byang chub bar// rdo rje legs pa skyes bu khyod nyid dang*// mi 'bral phyir na gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol/ de skad brjod cing dam can 'khor dang bcas pa mdun du byon par bsam la/ gdan 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ dam can skyes bu chen po ging gi tshogs// mched zla sum brgya drug cu 'khor dang bcas// sprul pa yang sprul sha za pho nya'i tshogs// 'thing nag 'bar bas gdan la bzhugs su gsol// hūm̐ dam can skyes bu srog bdag khyod nyid ni/ sangs rgyas bstan pa yun du skyong phyir dang*// 'gro bas don la thugs rjes brtser dgong la// ci bde bar ni bzhugs su gsol// de nas gtor ma 'bul ba ni/ snod gang yang rung ba'i nang du gru bzhi'i mkhar thab byas la/

de'i steng du bshos bu bzhag ra skyes skar khung gsum dang ldan pa yang bzhag /tha ma ra sha ra yi rnam lnga dang theb bskyur bskor la bzhag /phud ma nyams pa'i chang dang ra yi khrag bran la steg gi khar dar sna lngas brgyan la bzhag /de nas byin gyis brlab ba ni/ oṃ swa bha ba shuddho sarba dharma swa bha wa dho haṃ/ rang nyid rdo rje 'dzin pa'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ mdun du song ba las yaṃ las rlung*/ raṃ las me/ de'i steng du padma'i snod dang sgyed po de yi nang du gtor ma 'od du zhu ba la bdud rtsi kha dog rnam pa lnga dang ldan par gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ i dam bha ling kha kha khwa hi/ oṃ badzra sa tu sa ma ya/ baṃ kraṃ kraṃ ni kra ma ni/ sa ma ya sa tu tri dza dza hūm̐ baṃ ho/ bha ling ta kha kha khā hi/ ces brjod pas 'khor dang bcas pas gtor ma gsol bar bsam/ yang las sbyor du dgra bo'i sha khrag du bsam 'bul/ de nas bstod pa bya ba ni rol mo dang bcas pas/ hūm̐ dam can skyes bu khol po 'khor bcas la*// sha khrag dmar gyi gtor ma chen po dang*// ra yi rnam lnga tshil gyi dud pa dang*// dam rdzas sna tshogs dar gyis mchod pa rnams// skyes bu chen po 'khor dang bcas la 'bul// khams gsum stong gsum 'byung bzhi las grub pas// shel gyi mchod rten rin chen sna bdun nyid// dam rdzas bha ling la sogs thams cad kyi// dam can skyes bu khyod la mchod pa 'bul/ sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pas dgra bo dang*// bla ma la sdang gsang sngags smod la sogs// dam nyam dgra bo'i sha khrag mchod par bzhes// khyed la mchod pa 'bul bas bsod nams kyi// khams gsum sems can bde zhing skyed pa dang*// bsgrub pa po la tshe ring nad med dang*/ mthu dang longs spyod rgyas pas dngos grub gsol// hūm̐ dam can skyes bu chen po ging gi tshogs// 'gro ba'i don la thugs rjes sku sprul pa// gdug pa 'dul phyir longs spyod chen po sku// zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog dkar po la// ra la chib nas sku la dar dkar gsol// phyag g.yas ra'i rgyan mtshan bsnam nas kyang*// 'khor ba'i log rtog ma lus sel bar byed/

g.yon gyi phyag na mdung dar dkar po bsnams// dgra bgegs pha rol rgol ba bzlog par mdzod// dbu skra kham nag gyen du 'khyil// spyan rtsa dmar shing shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub// ljags ni dmar po glog ltar 'khyug pa yi// 'jig rten khams gyis log 'dren bgegs rnams kun// thams cad tshar gcod zil gyi gnon par mdzod// skyes bu bdud 'dul dreg pa kun sgrol shing*// 'jig rten khams kyis 'byung po 'dul ba yi/ dam can ging gi tshogs dang bcas la bstod// hūm̐ thams cad gtsor gyur dpal ldan kun gyis sras// sku mdog dmar po ber nag dgu brtseg gsol// g.yas kyis phyag na gser gyis rdo rjer bsnam// g.yon gyis phyag na gnad kyi rkyal pa thogs// seṅge bcib nas stong gsum ma lus nyul// sangs rgyas bstan la gnod pas dgra bo rnams// rdul du brlog cing khrag du skyug par mdzod/ mched zla sum brgya drug cur bcas pa dang*/ pho nya gcan gzan mche sder gdug pa can// yang sprul sha za srog gcod ging dang bcas// dam nyams dgra bos sha khrag rus pa dang*// don snying nang rol dbugs la da rol la// sngon gyi thugs dam gnyen po brtser dgongs la// rnal 'byor bcol ba'i las rnams grub par mdzod// dam can mgar ba'i mtshan can nag po ni// zhal gcig phyag gnyis dbu skra dmar ser 'khyil/ g.yas kyis phyag na khro chu'i tho ba thogs// g.yon gyi phyag na mgar kyis sbud pa thogs// ral pa bcing shing sku la ber nag gsol// spyan rtsa dmar zhing ljags ni glog ltar 'khyugs// dam nyams dgra bo gyur med myur du mdzod// zhal nas rkan sgra drag po brdab pa yi// log par lta bas dgra bgegs 'dar du chugs// srid gsum gdug pa'i tshogs rnams kun// zil gyis gnon cing dbang du bsdud mdzad pas// dam can mgar ba nag pos tshogs la bstod// hūm̐ sngon tshe rdo rjer 'dzin pas spyan snga ru// bka' bzhin nyan par dam bcas nas// rang rtag srog gi snying po phul// bstan pa bsrung bar dam bcas nas// gsang bdag phyag mtshan rdo rjer yi// sems skyed dbang skur dam tshig phog

/gsang mtshan rdo rje legs par btags// zhal gcig pa la phyag gnyis pa// sku mdog nag po du bas mdog /dbu la 'bo zhu chen po gsol// spyan ni sdang mig zur gsum lta// 'gal byed log lta zhe la gnon// snyan ni dge stag gi gtam la nyan// shangs nas rlung nag 'tshub mar 'khyil// las ngan dgra bo myos su chug /dmar nag zhal ni zur gsum bsgrad// bsgral bas zhing bcu bzhes su gsol// ljags ni dmar po glog ltar 'khyugs// las ngan dgra bo gyur mid mdzod// bsad bcad sgra ni 'brug ltar sgrog /dgra bo rmug shing myos su chug /rno gdug mche ba gtsigs pa yi// sdang bas dgra bos srog rtsa chod// dug gi kha rlang nag po yi// smyo 'bog khrag nad skyug du chug /sku la dar nag 'jol ber gsol// sdang bas dgra bos srog rtsa chod// g.yas na khro chus tho ba thog /log rta gnod byed phung po chom// g.yon pa mgar gyis sbud pa thog /sdang ba'i dgra bo thal bar rlog /zhabs ni gyad kyi dor thab can// bstan pa 'jig pa bsgral du gsol// yid dgas btsan gyi rgyal po khyod// mthu stobs nus pa rdzu 'phrul can/ 'gal byed log lta cham la phob// mgar ba nag po dus la babs// rdo rje legs pa dus la babs// dus la bab po sa ma ya// bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ mched zla sum brgya drug cu'o// pho nya gcan gzan gdug pa can// za byed mche ba can rnams kyi// dgra bo'i sha rus khrag la rol// de bas bka' la nyon/ rig gsum mgon po'i bka' la nyon// dam tshig gnyan po thub par srungs// skye mchog badzra thig le rtsal// mthun pas dam rdzas 'di 'bul la// bcol ba'i 'phrin las grub par mdzod/ ces pas gtor ma gtsang sar dor*/ de nas bshags pa ni/ hūm̐ dam can skyes bu'i thugs dam ci 'gal ba/ ma rig dbang gis nyes par gyur pa rnams// rab du 'gyod pas sems gyis mtho lo bshag /hūm̐ skyes bu khyod la phrag dog ma mchis kyang*// khyed kyis 'khor du gtog pa lha srin la// thugs dang 'gal ba mang po ci mchis pa// rab tu 'gyod pas sems kyis mthol lo bshags// bdag gi rab du bshag pas bsod nams kyi// bdag cag 'khor dang bcas pa yi// mi mthun gnod pa'i bsam pa rab zhi nas// don rnam ma lus 'grub bar mdzad du gsol// ces pa dang yig ge brgya pas kha bskong*/

dam can gyis bskyed rim dang las byang rnam lug lo zla ba bcu pa'i tshes gsum pa dpal ldan mtshur phu'i bsgrub gnas khyung rdzong du/ 'di yi bsgrub pa mdzad nas chos phyogs du bskos pa'i dus rang 'byung rdo rje sbyar ba rdzogs so// dpal phyag na rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo// las mkhan chen po bsgrub pa'i man ngag ni/ rang nyid gtum po nag por bsam la/ mdun du phyi'i rgya mtsho bsgom/ de'i dbus su rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i gzhal yas khang*/ yangs shing rgya che ba/ de'i dbus su padma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i dbus su phu ser po/ de 'od du zhu ba las sngags kyi bdag po ro stod mi ru 'dug pa khog smad du sbrul ltar yod pa sku mdog ser po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa thugs kar thal mo sbyar ba dbu la sbrul mgo bdun gyis gdeng ka dang ldan pa gzhon nu mdzes pa'i chad byad can rin po che rgyan cha du mas spras pa/ de'i thugs ka nas me long la gzug brnyan shar ba ltar phu ser po de las 'od zer 'phros nas rgya mtsho'i nang du song bas sngags kyi bdag po btsun mo sras dang bcas pa skad cig gis spyan drangs la/ dam tshig pa la bstim/ dza hūm̐ baṃ haṃ/ de nas spyan 'dren pa ni/ hūm̐ las mkhan chen po sngags kyi bdag po khyod// bdug pa ma lus tshar gcod klu rgyal sog ma med/ las mkhan gzhon nu gtum po 'khor bcas ni// dam rdzas mchod phyir gnas 'dir spyan 'dren na// bstan pa srung bas slad du gshegs su gsol// oṃ spu ta spu ta ma ha kro ta hūm̐ si ti si ti spo ta hūm̐/ na ga ra tsa a kar sha dzā hūm̐ baṃ ho hri dza/ ces mang du brjod cing spyan drangs nas gtor ma 'bul pa ni/ dkar gsum dngar gsum la sogs pa klu sman sna tshogs btab pa'i gtor ma rgya chen po dar gyi rgyan la bzhu de bas rang nyid phyag na rdo rje bsgoms shing*/ oṃ sarba bha wa shuddho sarba dharma swa bha wa shuddho ho/

stong pa nyid kyi ngang las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ bdud rtsi yig rgya kha dog dkar shing ro phun sum tshogs pa oṃ badzra smri ta hūm̐ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi char ltar bab nas dbyer med du gyur/ sngags kyi bdag po 'khor dang bcas pas lcags kyi gtor ma la zug nas gsol bar bsam la/ oṃ spu ta spu ta ces pa'i gsham la i dam bha ling ta kha kha kha hi/ ces bdun nam nyer gcig gi 'bul la bstod pa ni/ hūm̐ phyag na rdo rjer bka' nyan pa// las mkhan chen po 'jigs pas sku// thugs rjes rnam dag nyi ma na sting nas/ mnyam shing sku mdog ser po zud phud can// zhal gcig phyag gnyis mnyam sbyor sbrul bzhugs can// sku la rin chen bdun gyi rab spras nas// dbu la sbrul mgo bdun gyi gdeng ka can// brlab gnyis lto phye'i mjug mas rgyan du dkris// rnal 'byor dbang phyugs skyong bas mthu chen po// sngags kyi bdag po khyod la rab tu 'dud// hūm̐ sngags kyi bdag po chen po khros tsam na// gang bcol las rnams grub par de dus su// 'jig pas skur ston khros pas cha byad can// sku mdog dud kha nad kyis rkyal pa thogs// srid gsum tshar gcod dgra bgegs dbang du sdud// khams gsum bdag po gsod byed chen po ste// kha rlung nag po nad kyi na bun 'thibs// sbrul mgo bdun dang zur phud lnga pa can// gzhon nu chen po khyab 'jug khros pas gzugs// gzhon nu gtum po chen po nag po che// bdud po chen po khol po nag po che// bran po chen po las mkhan chen po tshul// gsod byed chen po dbug len chen po ste// khol po chen po g.yogs po chen po tshul// khyad la mthun pas sman dang gtor ma 'di// gnod byed bsgral bas slad du 'bul lag na// sngon tshe rdo rje 'dzin dpa'i spyan snga ru// ci ltar khas blang dam bcas nas// rnal 'byor bran la bkol slad du// mthun pas gtor ma 'di bzhes la// las mkhan chen po grub bar mdzod// hūm̐ las rnam bsgrubs byed sngags kyi bdag po khyod// rab khros nad kyi kha rlang dgra la thong*// sbrul thag zhag pas*/dam nyam dgra bo ching*// gsod byed las mkhan chen po dus bab// las mkhan chen po las la ma g.yel gcig

/gsod byed chen po sdang ba'i dgra bo gsod// rnal 'byor bka' bsrung las rnams myur du bsgrubs// ces gtor ma skyal dge ba bsngo'o// spyan drangs ba gshegs skyed pa rang la bsdu ba'am/ gtor ma la bstims pa dgra'i yul du nad skyal gsod pa bsam la skyal lo// sngags kyi bdag po'i gtor ma dang skyed chog rang byung rdo rje sbyar ba'o// rdzogs so/// /'di yi brgyud pa ni/ thub pa phyag rdor/ klu sgrub/ tai lo/ na ro/ mar pa/ mi la/ dwags po/ dbu se/ ras chen/ spom rag pa/ karma pa/ u rgyan pa/ rang byung rdo rje/ grags seng ba/ grags rgyal ba/ rgyal ba dpal/ de la bde ba'i bdag gi zhus so//
